content.title: Prepare a meeting: get the key points before it starts
content.problem: You want to read the key points the system prepared before the meeting, but do not know where to open them.
prerequisites: You are signed in and have at least one scheduled meeting
content.expected_outcome: You see the key-point summary for the meeting and can export it as notes.

content.title: Share a summary: send the key points to colleagues who missed the meeting
content.problem: You want to share the prepared key points, but are not sure which page creates the link.
prerequisites: You have a meeting whose key-point summary has already been generated
content.expected_outcome: Your colleagues receive a link that opens the key-point summary directly.

content.title: Set up notifications: choose which meeting reminders you receive
content.problem: You get too many or too few meeting reminders and want to choose which notifications you receive, and through which channel.
prerequisites: You are signed in and allowed to change your personal settings
content.expected_outcome: You receive only the reminder types you selected, only through the channel you chose.

content.title: Weekly digest: read the week's meeting highlights in one place
content.problem: You had many meetings this week and want to read every highlight at once instead of opening them one by one.
prerequisites: At least one meeting this week has already ended
content.expected_outcome: You see the highlights of every meeting this week and can save them as notes.
